prose.subject: Payment Required: Q3 Payroll Analytics Report
prose.body: Your request for the Q3 Payroll Analytics Report has been approved, but payment is required to proceed. This report provides a detailed breakdown of salary distributions, overtime exceptions, and bonus allocations for the specified period. The total cost for this dataset is 5108.81 USDC. Please direct your payment to the following wallet address: 0x008376e5fa97da65a41d1c9c480000aad858077e. Once the transaction is confirmed on-chain, the full report will be unlocked for immediate download. If you have already sent the payment, you may check your transaction ID to ensure it has been processed. For any questions regarding the invoice or the contents of the report, please contact our support team via the help center. Thank you for choosing Cobalt Payroll for your data needs.
